topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I should have seen it coming, the way the village changes, each season bringing something new, something that stirs the soil but leaves the heart heavy. When the landlord spoke of selling, it felt like a storm was brewing, not just over our heads, but deep in the roots of the earth we’ve tilled so long. I ought to have warned the others, spoken up before the papers were signed, before the land they stood on began to feel less theirs. Now, they talk of moving on, of unfamiliar sights and folk, and I wonder if my silence has sown seeds of doubt and fear. The harvest of this place will be different, the community not as tight. Saints preserve us, I should have spoken.
